# Database schema: primary (postgresql)

2 tables.

## billing.invoices

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Key | Comment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | bigint auto-increment |  | `nextval('billing.invoices_id_seq'::regclass)` | PK |  |
| `account_id` | bigint |  |  | FK → public.accounts.id |  |
| `number` | integer |  |  |  |  |
| `total` | numeric(12,2) |  |  |  |  |

Indexes:

- `invoices_account_id_number_key` (account_id, number), unique, backs a unique constraint

Constraints:

- `invoices_account_id_number_key`: unique (account_id, number)
- `invoices_total_check`: check `(total >= (0)::numeric)`

Foreign keys:

- `invoices_account_id_fkey`: (account_id) → public.accounts (id), on update no action, on delete cascade

## public.accounts

Customer accounts

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Key | Comment |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | bigint auto-increment |  | `GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY` | PK |  |
| `email` | text |  |  | UK |  |
| `external_ref` | uuid | yes |  | UK |  |
| `status` | account_status (enum account_status: trial, active, closed) |  | `'trial'::account_status` |  |  |
| `tags` | text[] |  |  |  |  |
| `data` | jsonb |  | `'{}'::jsonb` |  |  |
| `created_at` | timestamp with time zone |  | `now()` |  |  |
| `deleted_at` | timestamp with time zone | yes |  |  |  |
| `search` | tsvector | yes | generated stored: `to_tsvector('simple', email)` |  |  |

Indexes:

- `accounts_email_key` (email), unique, backs a unique constraint
- `accounts_external_ref_key` (external_ref), unique
- `accounts_lower_email_idx` (`lower(email)`), unique
- `accounts_live_email_idx` (email), unique, partial where `(deleted_at IS NULL)`
- `accounts_created_at_idx` (created_at desc nulls last), include (status)
- `accounts_status_created_idx` (status, `date_trunc('day', created_at)`)
- `accounts_email_pattern_idx` (email collate C text_pattern_ops)
- `accounts_tags_idx` (tags), gin
- `accounts_data_idx` (data jsonb_path_ops), gin
- `accounts_search_idx` (search), gin

Constraints:

- `accounts_email_key`: unique (email)
